mycli <command>

Commands:
  mycli serve [port]   start the server                         [aliases: s]
  mycli build <entry>  build the project from an entry file
  mycli lint [files..]  lint source files

Options:
      --version  Show version number                                   [boolean]
  -c, --config   Path to a config file                                  [string]
      --mode     Build mode           [string] [choices: "development", "production"] [default: "development"]
  -h, --help     Show help                                             [boolean]
